summary: Motorsport Games Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose amendments to its existing credit agreement with Citibank, N.A. The amendment modifies the financial covenant by adjusting the definition of Fixed Charge Coverage Ratio to include cash interest expenses in the denominator; it also extends the maturity of the promissory note from February 20, 2027 to February 20, 2028. No equity, merger, or special-situation event is involved. This is a routine debt covenant and maturity extension. The filing does not constitute a special situation; it is an ordinary modification of a credit facility.
